name: Venus: Build Your Destiny
detailed_description:
Venus is a sandbox action-adventure that merges RPG progression with creative engineering, physics-based construction, and high-stakes exploration.

Inspired by the planet’s dual nature—a breathtaking, cloud-covered sky contrasted with its harsh and unforgiving surface—the game delivers a rich, multi-layered experience. Venus invites you to design and construct innovative vehicles for mining and exploration, help shape a utopian city floating above the storm, and wield cutting-edge weaponry to face the relentless machine threat lurking below.

CREATIVE MODE

No limits, no rules—just pure creativity! In Creative Mode, you have access to every part, so you can build, experiment, and perfect your craziest ideas. Whether you're making something totally wacky or fine-tuning the ultimate machine, this is your space to play, test, and let your imagination run wild!

CHALLENGE MODE

Ready for a challenge? Take on a series of fun, fast-paced missions that test your creativity and skills! Build awesome machines to tackle tricky terrain, blast enemies sky-high, and pull off crazy stunts like flying, sliding, and jumping through obstacles. Try to beat your own records, or go all out designing the ultimate battle machine to cause maximum destruction!

STORY MODE

Take on the role of a brilliant engineer and construct one-of-a-kind machines to fulfill contracts and revive mining operations. Breathe new life into Cloud City’s economy as you build awe-inspiring floating structures high above Venus’s skies. Upgrade your gear, master new skills, and equip powerful tools and weapons to tackle any challenge. Explore both the soaring city and the planet’s unforgiving surface in search of Vebrium—the rare mineral that holds the key to your ultimate mission.

BUILD

Unleash your creativity and build groundbreaking vehicles and machines like never before! Whether it soars through the skies, drifts across the ground, rolls into action, ramps up for epic jumps, or twists with precision, the possibilities are endless. Powered by a deeply satisfying physics system, you can fine-tune motors, tweak suspension, customize controls, and map every movement to perfection.

FIGHT

Venus isn’t just dangerous—it’s crawling with robot zombies, lying in wait, ready to power up at the first spark of electricity! Defend yourself with wild, physics-based gadgets like force fields, balloons, winches, and even gravity itself. Or, if you’re feeling creative, build the ultimate battle machine and take the fight straight to them!

MINE

Command powerful machines to crush towering rock formations and carve new pathways across the rugged terrain of Venus. Deploy cutting-edge mining technology to extract valuable minerals, then haul massive payloads across the alien landscape to their destination. Precision, strategy, and engineering mastery will be key to conquering the planet’s challenges!

EXPLORE

Survive the brutal landscape of Venus and bring abandoned outposts back to life! These high-tech stations hold powerful weather control systems that could change everything. Explore strange, otherworldly biomes and track down Vebrium—a super rare mineral that’s the key to your biggest mission yet!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (latest SP) 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3 @ 3.0 GHz or higher (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 2070 Super
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® compatible on-board
  • Additional Notes: No internet connection needed for single player
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (latest SP) 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Quad Core i7 @ 3.6 GHz or higher (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 2080 Ti / 3080 / Radeon RX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® compatible on-board
  • Additional Notes: No internet connection needed for single player
